title: Skin mesotherapy in Cairo
description: Find out what skin mesotherapy involves in Cairo, how the ingredients influence its purpose and risks, and what to discuss before a course of injections.
answer: Skin mesotherapy involves small injections of a chosen preparation into selected areas. Adults asking about uneven texture or hydration can discuss the ingredients and alternatives at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. Suitability and the evidence for benefit depend on the product, skin condition and reason for treatment.
preparation: Share allergies, medicines and recent reactions to skin products. Avoid injection into irritated or infected skin.
howPerformed: The team reviews the ingredients and their intended purpose, then treats suitable areas after your agreement.
followup: Temporary bumps and redness may follow. Use the skin care advised and contact the clinic if redness spreads or swelling increases.
risks: Risks vary with the ingredients and include allergy, inflammation, pigment change and infection.
